requirement: Three links to one business (Google Maps, a listing page, a website) resolve to one business with one Google place

oracle.invariant: S1: social, listing, website and Google links are told apart; duplicates and a second Google link are judged, not merged. S2: the three real links of the test case give one place; match never guesses. S3: the listing page gives the business name, address, phone and geo, never the Organization.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: match: a place id or cid is exact
the three real links of the test case
the business node of a listing page
